title: Headless MCP access: launch + wire a free-session channel to a live moe-next project
description:
MOTIVATION (owner, live UnAI deploy 2026-09-17): a "free"/headless session (an agent, a CLI, this Claude session) cannot drive a running moe-next project. The browser control-room command route (POST /command, /affordances/read) enforces checkHeaders = Host + Origin + CSRF (http-listener-guards.ts:347); a headless POST with only the operator credential + x-moe-protocol-version gets 426/refused because the CSRF token is session-minted at pairing. So today the ONLY way to create a goal / read state is a paired browser.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS (measured, not assumed):
- moe-next SHIPS an MCP server: stdio entry apps/daemon/src/mcp-main.ts and loopback HTTP host apps/daemon/src/mcp-http/ (mcp-http-main.ts, mcp-http-host.ts binds 127.0.0.1/::1/localhost from an env port). It authenticates by CREDENTIAL/bearer, NOT the browser Host+Origin+CSRF wall — exactly the free-session path.
- goal.create AND goal.create_with_source are MCP-WIRED: they are NOT in MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS (that set is derived from OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS and only strips operator-only kinds — goal.cancel/goal.close were added there 2026-09-17). wiredMcpToolKinds() therefore includes goal creation, plus MCP_SERVED_QUERY_KINDS for reads.
- So the capability is ~90% present. The gap is launch + client wiring + docs, not build-from-scratch.

THE GAP:
1. `moe start` does NOT launch the MCP server (grep of moe.ps1 / moe-cli-main.ts: no mcp wiring). There is no operator-facing launcher that starts the stdio/HTTP MCP bound to a given project's store + credential.
2. No client wiring: nothing points an MCP client (an agent session, a .mcp.json) at a live project's MCP endpoint.
3. No skill/doc telling a free session which tools exist (goal.create_with_source, the read/query kinds) and how to reach a live project.

DELIVERABLE OPTIONS (pick the leanest in planning; MCP is the answer, skill/api are the client-side dressing):
- A `moe mcp <projectPath>` launcher (or a `moe start --mcp` flag) that starts the MCP server bound to that project's store + operator credential from moe.config.json.
- A documented .mcp.json / connection recipe so an agent session attaches to it.
- A skill (or INSTALL.md section) listing the goal-create + read tools and the connect steps.

Re-measure before planning (rails): confirm goal.create_with_source is in wiredMcpToolKinds() at HEAD; confirm mcp-http auth model (bearer, loopback, no CSRF); confirm the stdio entry's arg/env contract (project/store/credential).
definitionOfDone: A launcher (moe mcp <projectPath> or moe start --mcp) starts the stdio and/or loopback-HTTP MCP server bound to the named project's store + operator credential; verified it comes up against the live UnAI project (unai-9705356d4240) without a browser.

A free session (no browser, no pairing) dispatches goal.create_with_source over MCP and it commits GoalCreated on the target project; the round-trip binds the PRD source (displayPath/mediaType/text). Test asserts the exact reason code on both the accept and a refusal path (global rail: assert the code+layer, not just outcome).
The free session reads the goal catalog / a state query over the MCP query kinds and gets the new goal back.

A skill or INSTALL.md section documents the exposed tool set (goal.create/create_with_source + MCP_SERVED_QUERY_KINDS) and the connect recipe; bidirectional allowlist test still green (wiredMcpToolKinds set-equality).

Re-measured at HEAD and recorded in planningNotes: goal.create_with_source present in wiredMcpToolKinds(), mcp-http auth = bearer/loopback/no-CSRF, stdio entry project/credential contract. pushe directly to main!

EVIDENCE DETAIL 2/2 — the two bugs the live arm found, the gate, the foreign red, and the adversarial answers.

=== TWO REAL BUGS FOUND AFTER THE UNIT SUITE WAS GREEN ===
BUG 1, MODULE-CYCLE DEADLOCK (found by the LIVE arm; no test double could have).
  `node apps/daemon/src/cli/moe-cli-main.ts mcp D:/projexts/UnAI` printed NOTHING on either stream and exited 13:
    Warning: Detected unsettled top-level await at file:///D:/projexts/moe-next/apps/daemon/src/cli/moe-cli-main.ts:322
    EXIT=13
  Reproduced on the config-absent path too, which located it BEFORE runMcp ran.
  CAUSE: moe-cli-mcp.ts imported readConfig/preparePackagedLinks as VALUES from "./moe-cli-main.js". The entry is loaded as moe-cli-main.ts, so the .js specifier is a SECOND module record whose isMainModule(import.meta, process.argv[1]) is STILL TRUE (both sides resolve to moe-cli-main.ts). That copy re-enters the top-level `await runMoeCli(...)`, re-parses `mcp`, and dynamically imports moe-cli-mcp.js which is already in flight. Deadlock; Node drains the loop and exits 13.
  WHY EVERY TEST MISSED IT: vitest resolves ./moe-cli-main.js and moe-cli-main.ts to the SAME module and isMainModule is false under the runner. The suite was green with the CLI 100% broken.
  FIX (production): new apps/daemon/src/cli/moe-cli-project.ts + bridge holding readConfig, preparePackagedLinks, readLinkManifest and MOE_CLI_CONFIG_ABSENT, taking a NARROW `CliProjectIo {artifactRoot, log}`. moe-cli-main.ts imports from there and re-exports MOE_CLI_CONFIG_ABSENT for existing consumers; moe-cli-mcp.ts imports the values from there and CliIo as `import type` ONLY (erased, no runtime edge). Still ONE implementation of each reader. The reason is written into both modules' comments so the next editor cannot re-create it.

BUG 2, BRIDGE CENSUS (found by the apps/** leg; first full run was 1 failed / 739 passed).
    FAIL src/runtime-entrypoint.test.ts > has an exact .js bridge for every runtime module and none for test-tier ones
    +   "unexpected": [ "cli\\moe-cli-mcp.js" ]
  CAUSE: runtimeTierModules seeds from the package entry plus every module with its OWN <name>.test.ts sibling, and expands via /from\s+"(\.[^"]*)\.js"/g — which cannot follow a DYNAMIC import. moe-cli-mcp.ts is reached only dynamically, so its bridge read as scaffolding. Every other dynamically-imported cli module (moe-cli-replan-recovery, moe-cli-review-recovery) earns its bridge the same way.

planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
RE-MEASURED AT HEAD 2026-09-17 (rails: description claims are stale by default). Commands and results:

(1) `goal.create_with_source` IS MCP-WIRED. Compiled probe (tsx, inside apps/daemon/src, deleted in the same command) importing `./mcp-tool-allowlist.js` printed: TOTAL 43; goal.create PRESENT; goal.create_with_source PRESENT; goal.close ABSENT; goal.cancel ABSENT; session.open PRESENT; work.get_context/graph.get/documents.source_read/events.read/design.read PRESENT; EXCLUDED_N 29; QUERY [work.get_context, graph.get, graph.preview, product_contract.read, events.read, documents.source_read, design.read]. `MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS` = all OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS minus `session.open`; goal.create* are not operator-only, they sit in BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY (daemon-command-vocabulary.ts:24) with CAPABILITIES.GOAL.

(2) MCP-HTTP AUTH = BEARER / LOOPBACK / NO CSRF. `packages/mcp/src/http/http-session.ts:28,60,160-210` reads exactly one `Bearer <token>` from the `authorization` header and calls `port.validateBearer`; `apps/daemon/src/mcp-http/mcp-http-session-port.ts:61-103` implements it. `mcp-http-host.ts:88` LOOPBACK_HOSTS = {127.0.0.1, ::1, [::1], localhost}, `:196` refuses `MCP_HTTP_HOST_NON_LOOPBACK_BIND`. Grep for csrf/Origin/Host-check in mcp-http-host.ts: ZERO hits. Confirms the free-session path is NOT behind http-listener-guards.ts checkHeaders.

(3) STDIO ENTRY CONTRACT. `mcp-main.ts` = `readBootstrapCredential()` (packages/mcp/src/stdio/stdio-server.ts:48, reads MOE_SESSION_CREDENTIAL, throws naming the variable when absent/empty) + `readStoreDependencyEnv(process.env)` requiring MOE_STORE_PATH, MOE_PROJECT_ID, MOE_DAEMON_CREDENTIAL, else throws `STORE_DEPENDENCIES_ENV_MISSING: <names>` (daemon-store-dependencies.ts:22-32). It passes `fallbackCredential: credential` so an MCP caller authenticates AS the operator -- which is precisely why operator-only kinds are excluded from the roster.

(4) THE GAP IS REAL, AND SMALLER THAN THE DESCRIPTION SAYS. `apps/daemon/package.json` ALREADY declares bins `moe-mcp-stdio` -> ./src/mcp-main.ts and `moe-mcp-http` -> ./src/mcp-http/mcp-http-main.ts, and `dist/moe-windows/apps/daemon/src/mcp-main.ts` IS in the packaged artifact. But: `KNOWN_COMMANDS` (moe-cli-argv.ts:13) = [init, start, recover-review, recover-replan, projects, version, help] -- NO `mcp`. And the only MCP HTTP host actually composed at runtime is `agent-wrapper-main.ts:332`, i.e. ONE PER SEAT, inside the wrapper process, with a seat-scoped credential and a per-seat origin that dies with the seat. There is NO project-scoped, operator-launchable MCP endpoint. So a free session cannot attach to anything today.

(5) THE EXISTING CLIENT RECIPE IS ALREADY IN CODE. `agent-spawner.ts:181-189` writes `{mcpServers:{"moe-next":{type:"http",url:trustedOrigin,headers:{Authorization:"Bearer <credential>"}}}}` for claude seats. The free-session wiring is the same idea with the stdio transport instead.

(6) CONFIG CARRIES EXACTLY WHAT THE ENTRY NEEDS. `MoeConfig` (moe-init.ts:83-103) = {credential, projectId, schemaVersion, storePath}. One file read supplies all four env vars.

(7) PACKAGED LINKS ARE LAZY. `moe-cli-main.ts:241 preparePackagedLinks` -> `ensureWorkspaceLinks` (moe-cli-links.ts:138) creates node_modules\@moe\* junctions AT COMMAND TIME. A raw `node apps/daemon/src/mcp-main.ts` recipe in a freshly extracted artifact cannot resolve `@moe/mcp`. THIS is the decisive reason the deliverable is a CLI verb and not a documentation-only .mcp.json recipe.

(8) STDOUT IS POISONED BY THE EXISTING CLI SINK. `moe-cli-main.ts:307` wires `log: (line) => process.stdout.write(...)`. For a stdio MCP server stdout IS the JSON-RPC wire. `moe mcp` must route EVERY line (banner and refusal alike) to stderr. This is the single highest-risk detail in the task.

(9) LIVE TARGET IS REACHABLE. `/d/projexts/UnAI/moe.config.json` exists on this host, so DoD item 1's live verification against the UnAI project is executable, not hypothetical.

(10) SHAPE-CONSUMER ENUMERATION (rail: grep the SHAPE, not the symbol). `KNOWN_COMMANDS` has exactly two references repo-wide outside dist/: moe-cli-argv.ts:13,164 and moe-cli-argv.test.ts:4,96. The test at :96 ITERATES the roster, so adding `mcp` grows its own iteration and it stays green even with no parse branch -- the classic one-directional roster defect. The plan therefore mandates a SECOND, opposite-direction arm. No test asserts the USAGE block's full text (grep of 'moe start [dir]', 'moe projects' and 'USAGE' over the cli tests returned only unrelated hits at moe-cli-main.test.ts:341,382), so the help line is currently unpinned and the plan pins it.

(11) NO SIBLING OWNS THIS. moe.list_tasks over epic-f02c6977: 39 rows, 38 DONE, this is the only open row. The two producers it builds on -- task-c9a9bf3c 'Official MCP stdio adapter' and task-159be643 'Compose production Streamable HTTP MCP host' -- are both DONE and their surfaces are measured present at HEAD above, so no dependsOn is require
